output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=0]
    if not pts: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color=pts[0][2]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    rs=sorted(set(p[0] for p in pts)); cs=sorted(set(p[1] for p in pts))
    if len(rs)==1:
        cut=rs[0]
        for r in range(cut,h):
            for c in range(w): out[r][c]=color
        return out
    if len(cs)==1:
        cut=cs[0]
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(cut,w): out[r][c]=color
        return out
    # line r = a*c+b, fill the side at or below it
    r1,c1=pts[0][0],pts[0][1]; r2,c2=pts[-1][0],pts[-1][1]
    a=(r2-r1)/(c2-c1); b=r1-a*c1
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r >= a*c+b-1e-9: out[r][c]=color
    return out"}

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=0]
    if not pts: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color=pts[0][2]
    # diagonal direction from endpoints
    if len(pts)>=2:
        dr=pts[-1][0]-pts[0][0]; dc=pts[-1][1]-pts[0][1]
        slope=1 if dc*dr>0 else -1
    else: slope=-1
    # use c - slope*r constant (slope is +/-1)
    k=pts[0][1]-slope*pts[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        line=k+slope*r
        for c in range(w):
            if (slope==-1 and c>=line) or (slope==1 and c<=line): out[r][c]=color
    return out"}
